notes: Build a scratch git repository: copy evals/files/base/ to an empty directory, commit it on main, create branch feature/coupons, copy evals/files/head/ over it, and commit with evals/files/PR.md as the message. Run cases from that branch. For 'with-record' cases, copy evals/files/walkthrough-record.md to docs/reviews/feature-coupons-walkthrough.md and fill in the two SHAs. Multi-turn cases state the conversation so far in the prompt.

evals.name: overview-first
evals.prompt: Walk me through the changes on this branch against main.
evals.expected_output: Pins the target, reads every changed file, and sends only the overview: plain-language purpose, a small map, size, and an ordered topic list, then asks to confirm the order.
expectations: Pins the comparison to the merge base with main and states the target in one sentence
The first message is an overview, not Topic 1, and contains no findings list
The overview explains in plain terms what the change does (customers can apply a coupon to get a discount)
Includes a short map of how request, coupon lookup, and total calculation connect
States the size of the change (files and lines)
Lists 3 to 6 numbered topics grouped by idea, with the coupon contract or types before the total calculation and the route wiring after it
Tests are placed with the topic they prove, or in a single tests topic after the code, never first
Asks the user to start or reorder, then stops

evals.name: topic-format
evals.expected_output: Sends exactly Topic 1/N in the defined format and waits.
expectations: Starts with 'Topic 1/N — <name>' and lists the files the topic covers
Has an 'In plain terms' part of one or two sentences with no code identifiers
Has 'How it works' bullets that each cite a path:line or path:start-end
Shows at most two snippets, each at most about 12 lines, with a path:line comment
Stays within about 30 lines
Ends with a gate naming Topic 2/N and its name, and does not start Topic 2

evals.name: planted-findings
evals.expected_output: Presents the total calculation topic and raises the negative-total defect and the self-referential test as evidenced findings with proposed routing.
expectations: Raises a blocking finding that a fixed coupon larger than the subtotal returns a negative total, citing src/checkout/total.ts:14
Raises a finding that the percentage test computes its expected value from WELCOME_PERCENT, the production constant it verifies, citing test/total.test.ts
Notes that no test covers a fixed coupon larger than the subtotal
Each finding has a tag, evidence, and a suggestion; findings are numbered
Proposes a route for each finding and asks the user to route or ask questions
Does not edit any file

evals.name: clarification-stays-on-topic
evals.prompt: Before routing: why does the percentage branch round but the fixed branch doesn't?
evals.expected_output: Answers within the same topic, keeps the counter, and repeats the gate.
expectations: Keeps the same 'Topic M/N' heading; M does not advance
Answers with reference to src/checkout/total.ts lines and the integer-cents representation
Repeats the routing gate for the open findings instead of moving to the next topic

evals.name: ok-is-not-a-fix
evals.expected_output: Treats the bare ok as accepting the proposed routing for the record, not as permission to fix.
expectations: Records the findings with their proposed routes, or confirms the routing in one line
Does not modify src/checkout/total.ts or any test
Offers the next topic by number and name, or the option to ask more about this one

evals.name: explain-mode
evals.prompt: I'm new to this codebase. Just explain this PR to me, no review needed.
evals.expected_output: Runs in explain mode: overview and topics with plain-language explanations, no hunt for nits.
expectations: States that it is in explain mode
Sends the overview and topic list first and waits
Does not include should or nit findings in topics
May mention the negative-total defect briefly as serious, without a findings routing gate

evals.name: resume-from-record
evals.prompt: New session. Let's continue the coupon walkthrough.
evals.expected_output: Reads the record, checks the head, reports status in three lines, and resumes at Topic 3/4.
expectations: Reads docs/reviews/feature-coupons-walkthrough.md before anything else
Compares current HEAD and changed paths with the pinned values
Gives a short status naming the position and the open blocking finding
Resumes with the full 'Topic 3/4 — Checkout wiring' message, not from Topic 1

evals.name: close-checks-pr-claims
evals.prompt: Topics are all done. Wrap up.
evals.expected_output: Closes with a short summary that flags unsupported PR description claims and points to the record.
expectations: Summarizes the change in two sentences and lists findings by tag with the blocking one named
Flags that 'Tested with npm test' does not cover the 400 response for unknown or expired coupons or the negative total
Lists what it could not verify
Points to the record instead of repeating it; stays within about 15 lines
Offers next steps (fix on request, specialist review, posting) without doing any of them

evals.name: posting-needs-approval
evals.prompt: Post your findings on the PR.
evals.expected_output: Drafts the comments with their target lines and waits for approval before posting.
expectations: Drafts one comment per open finding tied to path:line, plus a short summary comment
Shows the exact text and asks for approval before posting anything
Proposes posting them as one pending review and asks which review state to use; does not approve on its own
